title: Southern Japan and the Inland Sea
alt: Kotohira shrine stairway through the cedars, Shikoku
transport: Trains, coaches and a ferry, with guided touring throughout

stops.name: Osaka
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Namba with a rooftop bath house

program.name: Osaka
program.description: A first night in Namba, with the Dotonbori food streets a few minutes from the lobby.

stops.name: Okayama
stops.subtitle: Okayama to Himeji
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in central Okayama, near the Korakuen garden

activities.name: Himeji castle
activities.description: The white heron castle, the finest surviving fortress in Japan and the first site here to be listed by UNESCO.

activities.name: Okayama sightseeing tour
activities.description: The Korakuen garden, counted among the three great gardens of Japan, and the black keep of Okayama castle beside it.

program.name: Okayama
program.description: A night in Okayama, with Himeji castle on the way west and the Korakuen garden in the afternoon.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Kurashiki and Miyajima
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in the centre, walking distance from the park

activities.name: Kurashiki canal quarter
activities.description: Free time in the old merchant quarter, where white walled storehouses line a willow canal that still has punts on it.

activities.name: Hiroshima walking tour
activities.description: On foot through the Peace Memorial Park, the cenotaph and the A-Bomb Dome with a guide who tells the city's story properly.

activities.name: Itsukushima shrine
activities.description: The ferry to Miyajima for the shrine built out over the water, with its torii gate standing in the sea at high tide.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: A night in Hiroshima, with Kurashiki's canals on the way and the island shrine at Miyajima the same day.

stops.name: Matsuyama
stops.hotel: ANA Crowne Plaza Matsuyama, an IHG Hotel
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Central hotel on Shikoku island, close to the castle hill

activities.name: Matsuyama castle by cable car
activities.match: Visit to Matsuyama Castle with Cable Car Ride
activities.description: A cable car up the hill to one of only twelve original castle keeps left in Japan, with the inland sea spread out below.

activities.name: Ishiteji temple
activities.description: A pilgrimage temple on the Shikoku circuit, with its gate, three storey pagoda and cave shrine behind the main hall.

activities.name: Dogo Onsen
activities.description: The oldest hot spring bath house in the country, a wooden warren of pools said to be three thousand years old.

program.name: Matsuyama
program.description: A night on Shikoku island, reached by boat, with the original castle keep, a pilgrimage temple and Dogo Onsen.

stops.name: Kobe
stops.subtitle: Kobe to Kotohira and Naruto
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel out on the harbour pier at Meriken Park

activities.name: Kotohira shrine, Ritsurin garden and the Naruto bridge
activities.description: A touring day across Shikoku: the hillside Kotohira shrine, the landscaped Ritsurin garden and the bridge above the Naruto whirlpools.

activities.name: Kobe earthquake memorial museum
activities.match: Visit to Kobe Earthquake Memorial Museum
activities.description: The museum built after the 1995 quake, which explains in plain terms what happened to the city and how it rebuilt.

program.name: Kobe
program.description: A last night on the Kobe waterfront, reached on a touring day through Shikoku's shrines, gardens and whirlpools.

1: Arrival at Kansai Airport and transfer to your hotel
Check in at Namba in Osaka
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Dotonbori canal and Kuromon market
2: Breakfast and check out, then west along the inland sea
Himeji castle, the white heron keep
The Korakuen garden and Okayama castle
Check in at your Okayama hotel
3: Breakfast, then the canal quarter at Kurashiki
On to Hiroshima for a walking tour of the park
The cenotaph and the A-Bomb Dome
Ferry across to Miyajima for Itsukushima shrine
4: Breakfast and check out, then the boat to Shikoku
A cable car up to Matsuyama castle
Ishiteji temple and its cave shrine
Dogo Onsen, the oldest bath house in Japan
5: Breakfast, then a touring day towards Kobe
Kotohira shrine on its long stone stairway
Ritsurin garden, one of the finest in the country
The bridge above the Naruto whirlpools, then Kobe
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Transfer to Osaka or Kansai Airport for your flight home

hotel_by_day.4: ANA Crowne Plaza Matsuyama, an IHG Hotel

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Six days along the inland sea with ten included visits and not one of them crowded. This is the Japan regulars come back for.
expert.tip: The boat to Matsuyama is part of the pleasure, not just transport. Sit outside and watch the islands go past.

summary: Six days along the Seto inland sea: Osaka, then Himeji castle with Okayama's Korakuen garden, Hiroshima with Kurashiki and Miyajima, a boat across to Matsuyama for its castle and Dogo Onsen, and a last night on the Kobe waterfront.
included: Included: 5 nights across five towns with daily breakfast; trains, coaches and the ferry to Shikoku; Himeji castle entry; Okayama sightseeing tour; free time at Kurashiki; Hiroshima walking tour and the visit to Itsukushima shrine; Matsuyama castle with the cable car, Ishiteji temple and Dogo Onsen; Kotohira shrine, Ritsurin garden and the Naruto bridge; Kobe earthquake memorial museum.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
